description: This header file declares external API functions related to the 'LpccoUdp' component within the ANSC framework, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions for this component.

methods.name: AnscCreateLpccoUdp

methods.description: Constructs a new LpccoUdp object with specified context and handles.

methods.name: AnscLpccoUdpRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified LpccoUdp object instance.

methods.name: AnscLpccoUdpEnrollObjects
